snippet.description:
Ready for another exciting adventure with Chichi Pingping? Let’s dive into the fun together!

😛 Subscribe for more videos for kids
https://bit.ly/3csrr0u

🎵 The Invincible Dino-Rangers

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side
“With terrifying teeth, here I am!”
I-- am-- Tyrannosaurus Rex
I can defeat /anyone /with my sharp-- teeth
“Graar” “Chi pi chi pi”

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side
“Head-butting king, here I am!”
I-- am -- Pachycephalosaurus
I can defeat /anyone / with my tough forehead
“Graar” “Chi pi chi pi”

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side
“With awesome wings, here I am!”
I-- am -- gliding pteranodon
I can defeat /anyone / soaring through the sky
“Graar” “Chi pi chi pi”

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side
“With terrific horns, here I am!”
I-- am -- three-horned triceratops
I can defeat /anyone / with my pointy horns
“Graar” “Chi pi chi pi”

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side
“Enormous body, here I am!”
I-- am -- (*giant) Brachiosaurus
I can defeat /anyone / with my heavy stomp
“Graar” “Chi pi chi pi”

We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
Fearless-- Chi chi ping ping by our side
We we we are the Dino dino Rangers
We’re afraid of nothing ‘cause we’re side by side (repeat)
